intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The Blue Note Club. Swing Queen is the best singer in town, but since she got ticked she can only sing in threes.

intro.speaker: Swing Queen
intro.text: One-and-a, two-and-a, three-and-a... darling, the audience left hours ago, and I can't stop.

intro.speaker: Clap
intro.text: Threes, huh? Fine. I'll just press really, really fast.

intro.speaker: Beats
intro.text: No! Don't mash! Triplets bounce. Listen for the bounce, then copy it.

intro.speaker: Swing Queen
intro.text: Listen to the little drummer, sweetie. Now... keep up.

win.speaker: Swing Queen
win.text: Ahh! I can sing in fours again! And twos! And whatever I want!

win.speaker: Swing Queen
win.text: You stopped mashing and started feeling it, darling. That's the whole secret.

win.speaker: Clap
win.text: It's like the beat leans back a little.

win.speaker: Swing Queen
win.text: Exactly. Now go wake up the rest of them. I'll be cheering.

win.speaker: Beats
win.text: Next is the Night Market. The Syncopator hangs out there... I hope he's okay.

lose.speaker: Swing Queen
lose.text: Too stiff, darling. Shake it out and try again.
